name: Captain competition readiness proxy v1
purpose: A frozen, conservative proxy for one bounded product-outcome improvement. It is not a predicted judge score or rank.

candidate_bonuses.description: The agent can semantically inspect and verify a generated evidence packet through bounded WebMCP tools.
The visible product has a complete packet lifecycle with distinct route approval, verification, packet approval, and download states.
The mission produces a deterministic, hashed, downloadable JSON evidence artifact rather than only a routing decision.
The agent records a verification receipt while final packet approval and download remain human-only.
